address: Rua Medeiros De Albuquerque 431, São Paulo, 05436-060, Brazil
bio: This restaurant has become one of the most talked-about addresses for affordable and delicious fresh pasta, so it’s hardly surprising there’s always a queue out of the door. The project was originally started by chef Marcio Shihomatsu, an aficionado of Italian cuisine, with his home delivery service. Following on from the success of this, and the arrival of chef Bia Limoni to run the kitchen, they opened a restaurant where handmade delicacies are now created daily. The compact interior features an open kitchen, where you can watch pasta being made, enhanced by a pleasant terrace for a relaxed lunch or dinner. The menu is full of excellent options, but the house speciality is the delightful agnolotti di agnello (pasta filled with lamb braised in white wine) with a butter sauce and mint oil ...
